beta.introduction: We're building an open, community-kept index of the world's libraries. Before we open the doors, a few hundred librarians, editors and readers are testing it with us.
beta.notePlaces: Places are limited. We add people in small groups.
beta.noteReset: Things will break, and data may be reset.
beta.entryDescription: Use the single-use invite code from your email.
beta.wrongPassword: This invitation is invalid, expired or already used. Check your latest email, or contact us for a replacement.
beta.unavailable: Beta entry is unavailable right now. Please try again later.
beta.rateLimited: Too many attempts for now. Please try again later.
beta.acceptedDescription: Taking you to the index. Found something wrong? The feedback button is on every page.
beta.waitlistDescription: Join the list. We'll email you when a place opens up.
beta.waitlistNote: Only used for beta access. No newsletter.
beta.waitlistSuccess: You're on the list. We'll write to {email} when there's room.
beta.waitlistUnavailable: We couldn't save your request. Please try again later.

betaWelcome.title: Welcome to the beta.
betaWelcome.intro: Help us make Libraries Global ready for everyone. Explore, try things out and tell us where something feels wrong.
betaWelcome.exploreBody: Search the Atlas, try the filters and browse public profiles.
betaWelcome.contributeBody: Suggest a correction, answer accessibility questions or start a discussion.
betaWelcome.teamBody: Create a free team workspace, invite colleagues and manage library work. Staff access still needs verification.
betaWelcome.apiBody: Try the beta API with an API Access subscription. Keys share one allowance per billing period.
betaWelcome.paymentBody: You can try the API Access checkout. Beta checkout uses Stripe Test mode: no real payment is taken.
betaWelcome.cardDetails: Expiry: any future date · CVC: any 3 digits. Use test billing details.
betaWelcome.copyFailed: Select and copy the number above.
betaWelcome.testOnly: Use this card only when checkout says Test mode. Don’t enter real card details.
betaWelcome.paymentsOff: Payment testing is unavailable in this environment. Please explore the other beta features.
betaWelcome.resetTitle: Beta data will be wiped before launch
betaWelcome.resetBody: Accounts, contributions, team workspaces and test subscriptions won’t carry over. Keep a separate copy of anything you want to save.
betaWelcome.feedbackBody: Expect bugs and unfinished details. Use Feedback to report what happened, what you expected, or an idea to improve the beta.
